title: rhamnus frangula f. heterophylla
intro: Rhamnus frangula f. heterophylla, commonly known as Alder Buckthorn, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rhamnaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestion and relieve constipation due to its health benefits, such as stimulating bile production and improving gut motility. The therapeutic actions of Alder Buckthorn include its anthraquinone glycosides, which act as a laxative, and its tannins, which have anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus frangula f. heterophylla include anthraquinone glycosides, such as emodin and aloe-emodin, which are responsible for its laxative effects and other therapeutic properties.
